title: sanguisorba polygama var. stenolopha
intro: Sanguisorba polygama var. stenolopha, commonly known as Chinese burnet, is a type of flowering plant in the rose family (Rosaceae). It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating menstrual cramps, thus providing potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Sanguisorba polygama var. stenolopha are attributed to its styptic and anti-inflammatory effects, which can help to stop bleeding and reduce swelling. The bioactive constituents of this plant include tannins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
